prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: reduced efficiency. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 39.8 °C (28% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 44.1 °C (23% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 46.4 °C (19% above healthy). Heat exchanger effectiveness has dropped below optimal threshold, producing elevated mean temperatures.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.87 s (within 1% of healthy). Sharp pressure transient and immediate switching between sensors indicate optimal valve response.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.36 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 391 W·min/l (within 2% of healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.3 % (4% below healthy). Motor draws full electrical power while circuit flow drops substantially, confirming internal fluid bypassing.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.3 bar (within 1% of healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.
